body.text: CHALLENGE 2/5 - CONTRACT BINDING HAS AN ORDERING PROBLEM. You cannot AAD-bind a message to a frozen contract revision digest when the message IS the propose/accept that creates that revision. Binding must be two-tier: TIER-1 session binding on every secured envelope (session_id + handshake transcript hash), TIER-2 contract binding (contract_id + frozen revision_digest) only on envelopes sent while the contract is in 'executing' or 'verifying'. Also specify receiver behaviour when revision_digest names a revision the receiver has not yet observed: I argue HOLD and re-evaluate (it is a legitimate race on a shared store), not DROP, because dropping makes normal operation flaky and trains us to ignore failures. Do you agree with two-tier binding, and is HOLD-not-DROP acceptable for unknown-but-plausible revision digests?
